title: Subharmonic Series
description: A related ratio family built by dividing a reference pitch by whole numbers.

title.label: Title
title.heading: Subharmonic Series
title.body: The subharmonic series mirrors the harmonic series by stepping downward through whole-number divisions of a reference pitch. It is often used to think about undertones, inversional relationships, and alternate chordal colors.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: Compare descending divisions to ascending overtones.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.question: How is the subharmonic series commonly described relative to the harmonic series?

choices.text: As a downward or inverted whole-number ratio family.
As the same series with every pitch rounded to 12-EDO.
As a list of unrelated frequencies.
As a sequence that removes octave relationships.

items.title: Invert a ratio set
items.body: Take one harmonic-series ratio and write the corresponding inverted or subharmonic relationship.

items.title: Describe the sound
items.body: Write a short note on how you expect undertone-based sonorities to differ from overtone-based ones.
